items.title: Louis James Interview, 1959-05-25
items.q: I know Punch from racing, you know. Punch is a player in racing. That's why he met me with Gabriel

ctx.x: I just wondered if you know Punch played with him too a while. Yeah, I don't remember, but I know Punch from racing, you know. Punch is a player in racing. That's why he met me with Gabriel, see? Well you knew Punch out there in the country. Oh yeah, oh yeah. Yeah, sure.
I guess he was born, I remember.
